title: Shipping Coordinator
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a Shipping Coordinator for a contract-to-hire position with a leading client in Columbus, OH. This is an on-site position.

Shift:  All shifts are 8 hours with a half-hour lunch. These are standard business hours, but the team likes to be available from 7 AM - 6 PM, depending on business needs

Compensation: $20.00 per hour W2.

Job Description:
The Shipping Coordinators' primary responsibility is to process incoming packages for the corresponding order number and ship them back out to the end-user. Additionally, the Shipping Coordinator's responsibilities include adding any requested accessories to those orders and double-checking the order against the device to ensure the proper equipment was received. They are also responsible for any task requested by the Shipping Lead position and Logistics Manager. The Shipping Coordinator's duties may include but are not limited to completing any clearance documents requested, final order review if behind, help with receiving incoming packages, and processing, or receiving pallet shipments.

Responsibilities:
  • Processing and tracking incoming shipments.
  • Managing the inventory of devices and accessories.
  • Matching incoming devices to open orders.
  • Processing shipments quickly to achieve shipping-related service level agreements (SLA).
  • Recording all data for outbound shipments.
  • Processing return orders from clients.
  • Equipping and provisioning devices as required.
  • Assisting with the final order review.
  • Assisting with tasks to ensure Logistics and client run smoothly.
  • Providing support to Helpdesk, Logistics, and Project Management teams.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.
Requirements:
  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Proficient with Microsoft Office Suite or related software.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent time management skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
  • Ability to function well in a high-paced and, at times, stressful environment.

title: Senior Systems Analyst
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a Senior Systems Analyst for our mortgage services client in McLean, VA. This is a 6-month contract to hire position requiring 5 days a week onsite.

Summary:

Senior Systems Analyst for the Enterprise Technology department with strong analytical qualities, sound technology experience, and excellent communication skills. Effectively support multiple concurrent workstreams in a fast-paced environment working closely with IT, business project stakeholders. The projects are related to the transformation of applications and capabilities used by various Multifamily Finance business divisions.

Multi-year Accounting Platform Modernization project to transform end-to-end accounting functions, streamline close activities, provide new subledger, improve controls, compliance with SOX policies, reporting, transparency, agility, and data-driven decision-making, while accommodating the increased volume of Multifamily Participation Certificates and K-deals, and addressing regulatory and market demands.

Act as a vital link between business needs and technical solutions, ensuring our clients' data applications and systems maintain the highest standards of reliability, efficiency, and security. Work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment, and utilize expertise in system analysis, data analytics, and Agile methodologies to support key initiatives across our client's organization through comprehensive requirements gathering, user acceptance testing, and process improvement.

Requirements:
  • 5+ years of related work experience relevant to system analysis
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, information management systems, or business administration or related experience.
  • Ability to work independently with a technical and/or infrastructure team
  • Strong problem solving and analytical abilities
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proficient with SQL, Excel, and Share Point, Jira, Confluence, Dremio, Beyond Compare, Visual Studio and familiarity with databases (DB2, Oracle, Sybase, SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL) and cloud platforms (AWS, Snowflake).
  • Experience in end-to-end analysis, design, implementation, and support of applications of varying implementation methods (on-premises vs. cloud, COTS vs. in-house developed, etc.)
  • Experience with Agile projects, and Operations involving production application maintenance, support, and business operations that adhere to SOX policies
  • Familiarity with metadata tools (e.g., Collibra), data lineage.
Preferred skills:
  • Experience with Finance and Mortgage industry
  • Experience with Accounting Systems, Subledgers
  • Advanced degree in Computer Science or related field
  • CSM/CBAP/PMP/CSPO and/or other technical certification

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Senior Project Manager to manage technical projects primarily within the Infrastructure, Network, and Security teams. With our client in the in St. Paul MN. This is a 6-month contract position. This role is hybrid working 1 day onsite per week.

Compensation: $70.00 – $75.00 per hour W2, depending on skill and experience level.

Description of Project
The Client is seeking one full-time Senior Project Manager to manage technical projects primarily within the Infrastructure, Network, and Security teams. Projects include:

  • Keep the Lights On (patching, certifications, lifecycle management, etc.)
  • ​Infrastructure Special Projects (Terraform Infrastructure as Code Project)
At a high level, the resource will provide project leadership for various projects within the Client.
The work is expected to be done with a hybrid of remote and onsite work. Onsite presence is required at least one day per week.

Project / Program Planning & Management
  • Develop comprehensive project plans using Waterfall & Agile methodologies.
  • Define scope, goals, deliverables, and timelines.
  • Coordinate internal resources and third parties / vendors for execution of projects within baselines.
  • Utilize departmental tools for project management, tracking, and reporting.
Team Leadership
  • Lead project teams and manage / coach junior project managers as appropriate to ensure service delivery.
  • Support a collaborative and productive work and PMO team environment.
  • Facilitate communication and coordination for projects / programs across cross-functional teams.
  • Accountable to lead change management and conflict resolution efforts within assigned projects.
  • Ensure teams have clear roles, responsibilities, and deliverables.
Stakeholder Management
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships to become a trusted advisor to project sponsors.
  • Communicate project status, risks, and issues to stakeholders and executive management in a timely manner to set expectations and escalate as appropriate.
  • Ensure alignment of project objectives with business goals through stakeholder management activities.
Risk & Issue Management
  • Proactively identify, assess, and manage project / program risks and issues through mitigation planning.
  • Monitor and report project / program progress and performance throughout delivery lifecycle.
Budget & Resource Management
  • Develop and manage project budgets, per governance requirements.
  • Allocate resources effectively to ensure project success through demand management and capacity planning for projects / programs assigned.
  • Monitor expenditures and ensure adherence to budget constraints.
Transformation & Organizational Change Management
  • Lead transformation and change management scope within projects and programs as appropriate, to ensure solution adoption and process adherence.
Process Improvement
  • Support the evaluation and refinement of project management methodologies and processes.
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives within the PMO
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and emerging practices.
Minimum Qualifications
  • High school diploma or GED AND nine (9) years of experience managing multiple IT and business projects
    • Note: Highest completed degree in the following majors: Computer Science, Business Management, or Project Management will count towards the minimum nine (9) years of required work experience.
  • Associates degree counts as two years of experience
  • Bachelor's degree or higher counts as four years of experience
  • two (2) or more years in a lead role that required collaboration across multiple divisions with stakeholders from varying organizational levels.
  • PMP or PgMP Certification
  • CSM or SAFe Certification
  • 2 years' experience with MS Projec
  • 1 years' experience with Azure Dev Ops
  • 1 years' experience with Jira
  • 1 years' experience with GitHub
Desired Qualifications
Certifications
  • CompTIA Security+
  • Cisco (CCNP)
  • Palo Alto Networks (PCNSE) or CISSP
  • Azure Fundamentals – AZ-900
Skills
  • Experience with PPM tools
  • Cybersecurity: CISSP, CISM
  • Networking: CCNA, CCNP
  • Infrastructure: ITIL, Cloud certifications (Azure, AWS)

title: Power Platform Engineer
description:

​Compensation: $65.00-70.00 per hour, depending on skill and experience level.

Job Description:
The Automation Engineer Sr's primary duty involves design work, specifically designing a tailored solution in order to meet a specific client request using automation technologies. In addition to the work of a more senior automation engineer, this position will coach more junior level engineers on best automation practices and techniques.
Job Duties:

  • Design, develop, and manage custom business applications using Power Apps (Canvas and Model-Driven).
  • Create and optimize business process automations using Power Automate.
  • Build data visualizations and dashboards using Power BI.
  • Develop, manage, and maintain AI-powered chatbots and virtual agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
  • Leverage Copilot Studio to create conversational experiences that integrate with back-end systems, including Dataverse, Azure services, APIs, and legacy applications.
  • Integrate Power Platform solutions with Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, and other services.
  • Work with business stakeholders to gather requirements, define use cases, and deliver solutions that drive productivity and user adoption.
  • Document technical specifications, workflows, and solution architectures for small-to medium-scale projects and deliver presentations with minimal supervision.

  • 7+ years technical experience

  • High degree of technical expertise/professional mastery to recommend process improvements

Genesis10 is seeking a Sr. Analyst with EPIC Healthy Planet experience for a 3 month contract position with our healthcare services client.  This will be a hybrid opportunity, with traveling 0-25% to California.
 
Compensation: $80.00 - 93.00 per hour W2, depending on skill and experience level.

Description:
Epic Healthy Planet analyst.

• Provide subject matter expertise in Epic Healthy Planet, including system design, build, testing, and implementation.
• Collaborate with leadership and end users to design and configure solutions, providing technical and clinical consultation, including workflow analysis and application configuration to support enhancements and issue resolution.
• Analyze workflows, data collection, reporting needs, and technical issues to support solution development.
• Translate business requirements into functional specifications; manage system updates, enhancements, and release testing.
• Ensure compliance with organizational standards for system configuration and change control.
• Troubleshoot and resolve application issues, escalating complex problems as appropriate.

Required Skills:
• Active Epic certification in Epic Healthy Planet
• Minimum of 5 years of experience in the healthcare industry, including at least 3 years of direct client-facing experience with healthcare domain knowledge such as clinical documentation workflows, patient portals, encounter closure, and patient flow management.
• Minimum of 4 years of experience with Epic implementation and/or support

Desired Skills:
• Team management and mentoring experience, both formal and informal.
• Proven ability to lead cross-functional teams through clear, effective communication and strategic collaboration.
• Experience in department build and implementation of Community Connect locations.
• Proficiency with Excel, Visio, PowerPoint and SharePoint

***Candidate cannot be working with other Epic health systems and must disclose.

title: Cost Basis BSA - Hybrid
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Cost Basis BSA with our client in the financial industry, located in Minneapolis, MN. This is a 6 + month contract-to-hire position. This role is hybrid, working 4 days a week onsite.
 
Compensation: $65.00 – $75.00 per hour W2, depending on skill and experience level.
 
Summary
Sr. Business Analyst is responsible for business analysis activities on medium to large size projects. The role demonstrates advanced knowledge and ability, and can apply the competency in new or complex situations and guides other professionals. The role is responsible for execution of all aspects of requirements delivery- planning, elicitation, analysis and documentation, management, and support - for changes to Business Areas and Technology.
 
Responsibilities
  • Perform requirements stakeholder analysis to identify impacted or influencing groups and stakeholder requirements responsibilities
  • Develop plans and accurate estimates for completion of requirements, continuously improving the level of detail and accuracy of estimates
  • Manage risks,  assumptions and constraints for requirements, and communicate to appropriate parties
  • Define the business analysis approach including tasks and deliverables based on the project and delivery methodology
  • Lead requirements prioritization and leverage techniques to drive out business priorities
  • Facilitate collaborative sessions with large and diverse business stakeholder groups to drive requirements discovery, analysis, and review
  • Apply advanced elicitation techniques to work with different types of stakeholder groups
  • Analyze and document scope of the business solution using enterprise-standard requirements methodology
  • Review, analyze and evaluate user needs to create systems solutions that support business strategies.
  • Create system specifications that drive system development and implementation.
  • Mining data from primary and secondary sources, analyzing and reorganizing data in a format that can be easily read. 
Skills
Must-have
  • 5+ years of Experience working as a Business Analyst with progressively increasing responsibilities in the areas of requirements management on large and complex projects
  • Proven experience with various project delivery methodologies such as Waterfall, Iterative and/or Agile
  • Experience in requirements planning and prioritization including stakeholder analysis and effort estimation 
Successful candidates will possess the following:
  • High Curiosity
  • Ability to turn conceptual ideas into business requirements
  • Ability to ask relevant, probing questions of SME's, regardless of authority level
  • These are both data heavy roles, so experience with API, SQL and data mapping are required
     
  Cost Basis:
  • Must have: Cost basis or back-office experience (Support of Trading or Operations teams)
  • Nice to have: This person will be looked at to help assign work and lead day to day tasks for the BA team, so experience as a lead BA/BSA would be helpful
  • US WM is undertaking a discovery and analysis effort to define requirements and design for modernization of the USWM cost basis technology platform.  The platform provides critical account realized and unrealized gain/loss information to over 80 downstream applications. The enhanced platform will reduce regulatory, resource, and service quality risks associated with operating the current platform, position operations to scale to meet future growth, and enhance interactions with field partners.
  • Strong driver needed, with BSA/Data Analyst skill set 
Nice-to-have
  • Professional in Business Analysis Certification (PMI – PBA)
  • Masters Certificate in Business Analysis
  • Certified Business Analysis Professional (IIBA-CBAP or CCBA)
  • Agile Certification (CSM, CPO)
  • Trading systems experience
 
Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.

title: Bilingual HR Business Partner (Manufacturing)
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a HR Business Partner for a full-time position with our manufacturing client.  The position will be located in Gaylord, MN. 
 
Compensation: $90,000 – 98,000/year.

POSITION SUMMARY:
Reporting to the Regional HR Director, the HR Manager provides leadership to the HR function serving as the liaison between management and employees at the manufacturing facility. The role provides consultation and partnership to plant leadership to promote positive employee relations, drive cultural values, and execute business strategy aligned with goals and objectives through use of data to build accountability and continuously improve. The position will participate in centralized HR projects that have impact across the entire company and will lead projects within their facilities.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
  • Drive the effectiveness of human resource programs by developing strategies to improve employee satisfaction, positive employee relations, and working conditions. Evaluates current human resources policies and programs by visiting worksite and communicating with employees regarding related issues.
  • Directs the work of the HR team to support both HR and business initiatives through setting priorities and objectives, leading, teaching, and coaching. Administer company policies and procedures, as well as union contracts where applicable.
  • Provides counseling and dispute resolution regarding employee issues through consultation and investigation with both employees and leaders, reviewing company policy and practice and providing recommendation for resolution.
  • Develop location recruitment strategy in alignment with company recruitment strategy and in collaboration with location HR team to attract and retain qualified candidates.
  • Interpret company policies where applicable to ensure consistent application and equitable employee relations.
  • Collaborate with Centers of Excellence to evaluate, design, and implement employee development programs to ensure employee have the appropriate skills and competencies to meet current and future operational goals.
  • Audits employee records for completion and accuracy. Authorizes changes to employee records when necessary.
  • Other duties as assigned.
Qualifications

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Human Resources or related field with Master's preferred.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Human Resources Manager preferable within a manufacturing environment.
  • Knowledge of local, state and federal laws and regulations regarding employment practices.
  • Knowledge of HR Systems and Payroll, including time keeping systems.
  • Ability to speak Spanish is helpful, but not required.
  • Ability to multi-task, deal with employees with diverse backgrounds, and builds positive employee relations at all levels.
  • Prior experience working in facilities that have been recently merged or acquired is a plus.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

title: Project Manager/ Scrum Master/ Defect Support
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Project Manager/ Scrum Master/ Defect Support with our client in the financial industry in their St. Paul, MN location. This is a 12 + month contract position. This role is 100% remote. Light travel may be required.
 
Compensation: $67.00 – $75.00 per hour W2, depending on skill and experience level.
 
Summary
  • PLANT Data Conversion – Task Manager (primary role)
  • Work with the client's Data Conversion team to ensure tasks are being completed and driven to closure.
  • Must ensure team is not taking on too much at any given point in time.
  • Assist Data Conversion "pods” in detailing tasks that need to be completed and tracking those to done.
  • That could mean stepping in to ensure communications have gone out on time or verifying a particular meeting has been scheduled.
  • Ensure team has its ceremonies and are productive in identifying problems and working toward solutions.
  • It may mean meeting with customers or our Client counterparts on occasion.
  • Document meeting notes, requirements, and testing needs/cases as needed.
  • Ensure those items make their way into the team backlog.
  • Participate in conversion activities in a designated support role within the Conversion Command Center.
  • Some travel required.
PLANT Data Conversion – Defect Analyst (secondary support role)
  • Support the Data Conversion team to drive issues/defects to resolution.
  • Meet with customers and our Client counterparts as needed to perform research and find a root cause and proposed remedy approach.
  • Document meeting notes, requirements, and testing needs/cases related to the data conversion from Cornerstone to DNA.
  • Help write stories to be logged in ADO along with the required acceptance criteria.
Key Responsibilities:
  • Assist in creating learning plans as needed to research and solve identified problems
  • Generate and track tasks in our backlog
  • Hold team accountable on driving work to done
  • Partner with internal and external teams to define any needed solutions to address conversion issues
  • Manage any administrative tasks like entering data into ticketing systems and periodically following up to ensure issues are moving toward closure.
  • Assisting team on any ad hoc or one-off needs so they can stay focused on primary tasks
  • Follow up with impacted customers to update them on progress or inform them of testing any applied solutions
  • Actively manage team backlog
  • Produce meeting notes from discovery interviews
  • Participate in story discussions in internal team meetings as needed
  • Research and capture requirements for User Stories and Tasks
  • Write acceptance criteria as needed
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (daily standup, demos, etc.)
  • Sit as a proxy for the Lead when needed
  • Meet with customers to fully understand the issue from their perspective
  • Collaborate with internal DNA SMEs to vet issue and derive a plan to uncover the root cause
  • Report up on progress of defect resolution
  • QA test, as needed, in preparation of moving to customer validation
Key Experience(s)
  • Prior work in a DNA implementation or Loan Servicing implementation
  • Prior experience as a PM or SM
  • Prior work managing defects, preferably in a DNA implementation or Loan Servicing Implementation
  • Understanding of Agile (SCRUM) practices
  • Story writing in Agile formats
  • Previously participated in Data Conversion
  • Previous work on Client products, specifically DNA (not required but a bonus)
Key Skill(s):
  • Well organized, ability to stay focused to drive issues to completion
  • Good List Maker, Attention to detail
  • Good communicator, both written and verbal
  • Driver – Get things to done
Key Technology /Certification(s):
  • None Required
  • CPM or CSM a plus
  • ADO experience a plus

title: IT Applications Manager
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a IT Applications Manager for a Direct Placement with our manufacturing services client in Hopkins, MN.  This role is 100% onsite. 
 
Compensation: $155,000 to $165,000/year, depending on skill and experience level.

POSITION SUMMARY :
The IT Applications Architect serves as a key technical and functional leader within the organization, responsible for designing and delivering robust solutions that align business needs with IT capabilities. This role leverages expert-level knowledge of SAP systems, integration, and business processes to drive innovation, lead projects, and mentor team members.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

Business and Functional Expertise
  • Demonstrates strong business-functional knowledge and translates it into effective SAP configurations.
  • Serves as a trusted advisor to multiple functional groups, providing guidance and expertise.
  • Supports business plans and strategies by delivering innovative IT solutions aligned with organizational goals.
  • Provides expert-level advice on business processes, policies, and practices, ensuring alignment with IT systems.
  • Define the overall architecture across SAP modules (e.g., S/4 HANA, FICO, MM, SD, EWM, etc.).
  • Ensure integration between SAP and non-SAP systems (middleware, APIs, 3rd party tools).

SAP Configuration and Technical Leadership
  • Possesses expert-level SAP configuration skills across multiple functional areas, with a focus on integration and complex interfaces.
  • Recommends upgrade/patch strategies and evaluates future maintenance costs for budgeting purposes.
  • Demonstrates a solid understanding of ABAP development, data loads, data conversions, and interfaces, with an ability to debug and troubleshoot effectively.
  • Explores and implements new technology trends to deliver innovative business opportunities.
  • Evaluate when to use SAP standard features versus when custom development is justified.
Project Leadership and Execution
  • Leads projects of varying sizes, showcasing the ability to manage complex initiatives and deliver results.
  • Develops and completes project feasibility studies, charters, and methodologies with precision and thoroughness.
  • Coordinates contractor activities on projects and ensures effective project completion performance reviews.
  • Coaches and mentors team members on small to medium-sized projects to build their skills and knowledge.
Team Collaboration and Coaching
  • Provides effective coaching, feedback, and performance appraisals to team members and project staff.
  • Collaborates across teams, supporting problem resolution and technical issue troubleshooting.
  • Mentors IT and functional team members, sharing knowledge and expertise to strengthen the organization's capabilities.
Support and Maintenance
  • Acts as a system owner, ensuring smooth operations and recommending system improvements.
  • Utilizes online resources to efficiently identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical issues.
  • Coordinates support activities and demonstrates resourcefulness in resolving cross-functional challenges.
Strategic Contribution
  • Translates business strategies into scalable IT architectures and solutions.
  • Stays ahead of technology trends and identifies opportunities to enhance business capabilities.
  • Effectively architects integration requirements for diverse software solutions.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
  • Expert-level SAP configuration knowledge spanning multiple functional areas.
  • Extensive experience (typically 12+ years) in SAP configuration, functional processes, and technical integration.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to align IT capabilities to business goals.
  • Proficient in writing programming specifications and working with MS Desktop tools.
  • Basic understanding of network, Unix, Windows Server, security, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Effective communicator with strong leadership and coaching capabilities.
  • Demonstrated strength in IT project methodologies, from feasibility to delivery.
  • Proven track record of leading projects and coaching technical teams.
 
PREFERRED EDUCATION, EXPERIENCE AND SKILLS:
  • Experience in SAP modules related to supply chain (EWM, ECC WM, MM, PP, APO, IBP, etc.)
  • Experience with shop floor tools like Redzone and Rockwell
  • Experience with rolling out solutions (e.g. SAP) to a new production plant location
  • Experience with acquisition process and technical integration
  • Familiarity and ability to support with PPDS
  • Experience in a food manufacturing environment

  • 7+ years of experience in data modeling for analytics or data warehousing with strong expertise in Kimball methodology, dimensional modeling, and star schema design.

title: Senior SQL Server Database Developer
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Sr. SQL Database Developer with our client in the financial services industry. You can work from Plano, TX or Portland, OR. This is a for this full time, permanent job opportunity.
 
Description:
The Senior SQL Server Database Developer is the enterprise expert for designing, developing, and optimizing data processing systems and pipelines used to populate data into transactional databases, data warehouses, data marts, or other data repositories. A Senior SQL Server Database Developer builds systems to create and optimize data sets and data systems for operating applications, performing analysis, or identifying business or technology issues. You will be responsible for operational support and incident/problem management, from creating logging instrumentation to analysis and process improvements. They also coordinate with other IT teams to configure and implement security, monitoring, tooling, and related capabilities as they apply to their assigned systems. You will report to the Associate Vice President of Corporate Services Technology.
 
Responsibilities:
  • Use Agile practices to elicit and refine requirements through an iterative process of planning, defining acceptance criteria, prioritizing, developing and delivering enterprise data asset solutions in collaboration with business intelligence teams, our users, or other IT teams
  • Develop, configure, customize and manage integration tools, databases, warehouses and analytical systems with the use of data related software
  • Design, build, and deploy data extraction, transformation, and loading processes and pipelines from various sources including databases, APIs, and data files
  • Develop and deploy structured, semi-structured, and unstructured data storage models such as data vault or dimensional modeling on a variety of platforms
  • Coordinate security, application monitoring, development tooling, and related capabilities with responsible teams
  • Provide operational support and incident management for data pipelines and data flows, including proactively updating internal clients and relevant parties on status changes and issues encountered
  • Author and maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation for processes, procedures, and technical designs
  • Train junior data and business intelligence personnel across the company, including developing material, mentoring, and guiding junior personnel on their technical skill growth
 
Requirements:
  • 15+ years' experience developing data-related solutions and software
  • 10+ years of experience working with relational databases and applying it in various applications, including within the Microsoft Azure platform
  • 4+ years of experience with multiple cloud technologies in the Microsoft Stack (Azure IaaS and PaaS) along with familiarity with alternative cloud technologies
  • 4+ years of experience designing and development on-premises and cloud-based (Azure) infrastructure and platform components
  • 4+ years of hands-on development and deployment experience with Azure cloud using .NET, T-SQL, Azure SQL, Azure Storage, Azure Data Factory, Cosmos DB, GitHub, Azure DevOps, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Advanced knowledge of Extract/Transform/Load (ETL) and/or Extract/Load/Transform (ELT) tools, including both batch and real-time data transmission applications such as SSIS, Informatica, Kafka, Spark, MuleSoft, or equivalent software
  • Advanced knowledge of database technologies such as Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle, or NoSQL databases
  • Advanced knowledge of multiple programming languages, such as C#, Java, Python, SQL, Scala, or similar
  • Advanced knowledge of IT infrastructure standards and tools, such as application performance monitoring, IT service management, or DevOps software
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or other relevant field

title: Application Programmer
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking an Application Programmer with our client in the financial industry located in Addison, TX and Charlotte, NC. This is a 12+ month contract-to-hire position.

Responsibilities:
  • Lead the design and implementation of automated testing solutions across UI, API, and database layers
  • Contribute to quality engineering efforts in a fast-paced Agile environment, ensuring robust and scalable automation coverage
  • Develop and maintain automation frameworks using Selenium WebDriver with Java/Python/C# for UI testing
  • Implement API test automation using RestAssured, Postman, or SoapUI, including authentication, payload validation, and response verification
  • Build and execute SQL-based validations for backend testing across Oracle, SQL Server, and NoSQL databases
  • Integrate test automation into CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI, or DevOps
  • Design and automate ETL testing workflows using SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
  • Validate data transformations, load processes, and data integrity across staging and production environments
  • Perform test automation and data validation on Hadoop ecosystems using tools like Hive, Pig, or Spark SQL
  • Collaborate with data engineering teams to ensure test coverage for big data pipelines and distributed systems
  • Develop comprehensive regression suites for end-to-end testing across UI, API, and DB layers
  • Ensure test coverage for business-critical workflows and edge cases
  • Maintain test data strategies for dynamic and static datasets
  • Work closely with developers, QA analysts, and DevOps engineers to align automation efforts with release cycles
  • Generate detailed test execution reports, logs, and dashboards
  • Participate in code reviews and contribute to automation best practices and standards

Requirements:
  • Proficiency in Selenium WebDriver with Java, Python, or C#
  • Strong experience in API testing and automation using RestAssured, Postman, or similar
  • Advanced SQL skills and experience with relational and NoSQL databases
  • Hands-on experience with SSIS for ETL automation and validation
  • Exposure to Hadoop ecosystem and big data testing tools (Hive, Pig, Spark)
  • Familiarity with test frameworks like TestNG, JUnit, PyTest
  • Experience with Git, Jenkins, Docker, and CI/CD pipelines
  • Understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies
  • Strong development skills in Selenium-based frameworks, data integration technologies like SSIS, and big data platforms such as Hadoop

Desired skills:
  • Experience with BDD frameworks (Cucumber, SpecFlow)
  • Knowledge of performance testing tools (JMeter, Gatling)
  • ISTQB or equivalent certification

Pay range: $58.26 - $66.26

Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.

title: Production Support/Unix System Admin
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Production Support/Unix System Admin with our client in the financial industry located in Charlotte, NC, Pennington, NJ, and Plano, TX. This is a 12+ month contract position.

Responsibilities: 
  • Provide support to end users responding to issues related to Incidents and Problem Management, for multiple applications, with the primary focus on triage leadership of all business impacting incidents
  • Understand and ensure compliance with the Incident Management and Problem Management policies and procedures
  • Key focal point for the customer/client/associate experience and own restoring any impacts to those experiences regardless of where the root cause of the impact lies
  • Lead production support triage efforts for low to moderate impacting incidents, manage bridge line troubleshooting and appropriate team engagement, engage in technical research and troubleshooting, and escalate to next level of leadership as needed
  • Identify business impact, interpret monitors, dashboards, and logs; write queries to accurately calculate impacts as applicable to the line of business and work with senior team members or Technology Services Specialist to validate impacts and communicate all impacts to leadership, communications channels and so on
  • Provide status updates and technical detail for awareness communications, ensure accuracy of all communications sent, and ensure any necessary reconvenes are scheduled
  • Communicate clearly with all levels of management
  • Identify possible production failure scenarios, vulnerabilities, and opportunities for improvement, and take ownership of escalation
  • Support 24 x 7 On Call responsibilities for any business impacting incident
  • Governance and Stakeholder Management 
  • Contribute to artifacts needed for governance forums
  • Understand stakeholder expectations and create regular updates to keep stakeholders informed
  • Achieve sustainable results 
  • Track the effectiveness of solutions through KPI's
  • Incorporate technical and financial factors when comparing different approaches to solutions
  • Influence decisions 
  • Present their own point of view with a clear rationale, facts and figures
  • Clearly display how their proposed solution or course of action is superior to other options by using facts/evidence to support it
  • Promote collaboration 
  • Collaborate with own team and across teams
  • Ask questions to obtain views from others
  • Participate in problem-solving discussions and suggest ideas as opportunities arise
  • Accept that new ways of doing things can improve individual and team results

Requirements: 
  • Significant experience supporting applications hosted on Unix, particularly AIX, via command line
  • Familiarity with scripting technologies such as Perl, Bash or Python
  • Experience with SQL*plus – writing and executing SQL queries to pull operational data as needed using a tool like TOAD
  • Experience supporting applications that leverage IBM MQ, SFTP, NDM and Autosys or another comparable job scheduling technology
  • Experience troubleshooting and achieving service restoral for complex Production incidents
  • Experience partnering with various technical teams to identify root cause, corrective action, and any other opportunities to improve system stability stemming from complex Production incidents
  • Strong, courageous communicator capable of effectively communicating, verbally, via emails and instant messaging, to both technical and business teams
  • Capable of working in high pressure situations
  • Experience coordinating with offshore/onshore teams and delegating work in a 24 X 7 model
  • Production Support – Working knowledge of supporting one or more business services within their business line, and associated maintenance, change, control, incident and problem management
  • Learns and adapts – Demonstrates the ability to apply theory to practice and incorporates the feedback from others and shallow knowledge of firm policies and standards in creating their mental models of software and infrastructure services
  • Demonstrates the ability to self-identify problems spanning a small, related set of software processes or a few infrastructure service domains
  • Demonstrates a willingness to accept situational changes and differences in the approach and/or opinion of others. Is willing to test new approaches
  • Analytical thinking – Possesses knowledge of prior solutions to existing problems and applies them to solve similar problems
  • DevOps Practices and Automation - Basic knowledge of automation and continuous delivery practices
  • Ability to participate in their role and utilize necessary tools with minimal guidance
  • Solution Design – Has knowledge of application/infrastructure/software design but has not been involved in hands-on design
  • Understands business requirements
  • Application, Data and Infrastructure Architecture – Basic awareness of architecture and design
  • Ability to comply with client standards for information security and business architectures
  • Business Products and Strategy – Basic awareness of products, services, business flows and strategy
  • Financials and Resource Management – Basic understanding of financial data and the impact that their role has within a team
  • Portfolio, Program, and Project Management – Initial exposure and working knowledge of project management fundamentals, enterprise change management policies and standards, and lifecycle management (i.e., both Agile/Waterfall methodologies)
  • Risk Management – Understands the basic elements of risk and control within the organization
  • Solution Delivery Process – Is learning their role, tool sets and processes within the software/infrastructure lifecycle

Desired skills:  
  • Ability to program (structured and OO) with one or more high level languages, such as Python, Java, C/C++. Ruby and JavaScript
  • Experience developing scripts to automate routine operational activities, ideally executed using a tool like Bladelogic or Ansible Tower
  • Familiarity with Site Reliability Engineering concepts
  • Experience with ITSM Remedy
  • Experience developing advanced monitoring capabilities using tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Glassbox, and/or NetScout

Pay Range:  $40.86 - $48.86

title: Application Architect
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking an Application Architect with our client in the financial industry located in Jersey City, NJ. This is a 12+ month contract position.

Responsibilities: 
  • Lead the migration of AP and FA modules from legacy ERP systems (like SAP) into Oracle Fusion Cloud
  • Own the end-to-end architecture, solution design, and delivery coordination for this multi-country rollout
  • Hands-on, high-visibility role that will collaborate closely with finance, IT, compliance, and vendor partners to deliver scalable Oracle Cloud solutions that meet both operational and regulatory needs
  • Lead architecture and end-to-end solution design for Oracle Cloud ERP migration (AP and FA)
  • Define the target state architecture and document the design using Oracle-standard frameworks
  • Create clear, executive-facing presentations and lead stakeholder workshops
  • Translate business requirements into secure, scalable Oracle configurations and processes
  • Facilitate discovery sessions and propose process optimizations wherever applicable
  • Define and manage integrations with internal and external client systems such as expense applications, tax engines, and eInvoicing tools
  • Track project milestones, deliverables, and dependencies across functional and technical teams
  • Lead a team of developers and functional analysts to deliver configurations and enhancements
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across business and IT groups, and own key decisions
  • Weekly status updates, risk tracking, and project dashboard inputs
  • Functional design documents and configuration specs (HLD, BR100, MD50, etc.)
  • Integration design and technical specs
  • Executive presentations and decision support materials
  • UAT strategy, data migration reconciliation plans, and go-live cutover plans

Requirements: 
  • 8+ years in ERP transformation with at least 2 full-cycle Oracle Cloud ERP Financials implementations
  • Deep functional experience in Accounts Payable and Fixed Assets modules
  • Strong experience designing and deploying Oracle Fusion configurations and workflows
  • Proven ability to create and present executive-level content
  • Solid understanding of data migration strategy and reconciliation approaches
  • Experience leading technical and functional teams across workstreams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, able to bridge business and IT
  • Experience migrating from SAP ECC, PeopleSoft, JD Edwards, or other legacy ERP platforms
  • Exposure to Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), BI Publisher, OTBI
  • Familiarity with eInvoicing, expense management, tax processing, intercompany processing
  • Oracle Financials certification or specialization in AP/FA modules
  • Owns the full solution, from architecture to delivery
  • Thinks strategically, acts tactically
  • Comfortable leading in a matrixed environment with global stakeholders
  • Bias for action and clear decision-making
  • Communicates with clarity and confidence
  • Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP
  • ERP migration architect
  • Accounts Payable solution lead
  • Fixed Assets Oracle Fusion
  • ERP transformation lead
  • Legacy to Oracle migration
  • Oracle ERP financials implementation
  • Functional architect Oracle Cloud
  • Finance systems architect

title: Insurance Document Associate
description:
Genesis10 is seeking an Insurance Document Associate for a full-time position with a financial services company located in Milwaukee, WI. This role is 100% onsite.

Compensation: $14.00 - 15.00 per hour.

Summary:
As an Insurance Document Associate, you will work as part of a team responsible for opening, evaluating, acknowledging, and distributing mail in support of an assigned business unit. You will ensure incoming mail reaches the correct destination, officially identify and acknowledge receipt of all incoming mail, and report required information to the underwriter. This role requires accuracy, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities:
  • Mail Processing & Distribution
  • Open, evaluate, and route mail to the appropriate business area.
  • Officially identify and acknowledge receipt of all incoming mail per established guidelines.
  • Report relevant information to underwriters and complete associated forms.
  • Receive and slot mail for distribution, sort and deliver printouts, manage FedEx sorting and distribution, and assist with electronic document conversion.
  • Complete underwriting and/or claims document review and audit by identifying and analyzing applications and documents for all product lines.
  • Review high-priority insurance, mail, and claim documents; identify and reroute misrouted forms.
  • Coordinate and classify documents per product guidelines and prepare them for scanning with correct ID sheets and order.
  • Process checks and DI benefits mail per established procedures, including indexing and routing as needed.
  • Analyze and review documents auto-classified/indexed by the system to identify and correct issues.
  • Review and ensure correct document type, policy number, and insured name.
  • Identify and manually index documents not recognized by the system.
  • Verify image quality, delete blank pages, and rescan as necessary.
  • Review and process underwriting and claims faxes, ensuring proper order and classification.
  • Meet all SLAs for accuracy and timeliness.
  • Handle original document requests and assist with testing and validation of document classification systems.
  • Support LAN monitoring and perform other duties as assigned by Team Leader or Manager.
Qualifications:
  • High school diploma or equivalent required.
  • 1–2 years of prior mail handling or customer service experience required.
  • Strong ability to coordinate and prioritize under tight time constraints.
  • High degree of accuracy and ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic PC proficiency and ability to navigate multiple systems.
  • Proven team player with strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential information in compliance with privacy laws and company standards.
  • Must be able to lift 15–20 lbs consistently.
  • Only candidates available and ready to work directly as Genesis10 employees will be considered for this position.
  • Able to work as a W2 employee of Genesis10 (no corp to corp).

title: Epic General Ledger Analyst
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a Senior IT Business Analyst (Epic General Ledger) with our client located in Shaker Heights, OH. This is a direct hire, W2 position. This is a remote position.

Salary: $100-110k

Job Description:

The Senior Epic Analyst designs, configures, tests, and implements changes of assigned Epic system applications. They will lead operational work groups and teams to gather and analyze requirements for new requests. In this role, the senior Epic Analyst consults with Epic representatives, leadership, and subject matter experts to engage stakeholders to configure and build Epic software and applications. The role includes the management of projects; working through complex problems, performing and supporting application upgrades, provides solutions, develops and documents workflows harmonized with systems, and supports the implementation life cycle to include end user adoption.

Responsibilities:
  • Leads needs assessment, software design, implementation and support.
  • Collaborates with reporting team to support operational partners need to gather requirements.
  • Independently facilitates design of workflows in conjunction with the appropriate subject matter experts; workflows will focus on designing improved efficiencies, solving complex workflow issues and incorporating quality initiatives.
  • Mentors other analysts with completing design workflows and analysis.
  • Leads functional and integrated testing of the software to ensure that the design objectives are met, including the development and validation of testing scripts.
  • Defines and develops user access security to protect the system while providing users with the access required.
  • Oversees, reviews, and moves build to production as required.
  • Comprehends with high degree of clinical or business departments' processes and partners with them to develop supporting workflows
  • Evaluates possible implementation of new technology, consistent with the goal of improving existing systems and technologies and in meeting the needs of the business.
  • Participates and contributes in operational meetings to provide Information Technology support and expertise.
  • Testing
  • Performs unit testing of all need build they are assigned and assists other application analyst as needed.
  • Leads functional and integrated testing of software to ensure that design objectives are met, including development and validation of testing scripts.
  • Develops, modifies and maintains integrated testing scripts owned by their areas.
  • Project and Change Management
  • Leads projects following the framework of the Enterprise Project I Management Office on all phases of a project from scoping and design through implementation and transition to operations.
  • Collaborates across teams to develop change management strategy and plans for implementations.
  • Develops plans to address impacts from system changes when implementing new functionality.
  • Maintenance/Support
  • Supports and troubleshoots interfaces for inbound/outbound transaction errors; helps monitor interface error queues.
  • Troubleshoots application issues, with/without vendor assistance to resolution.
  • Leads escalation of issues with appropriate internal resources, to resolution.
  • Independently leads application upgrade tasks and troubleshooting efforts and provides guidance to application analysts and leadership.
  • Provides 24 x 7 support scheduled and routine assignments for on-call rotation.
  • Maintains security for assigned applications.
  • Adheres to change control processes per best practice and processes defined to protect the system(s).
  • Mentoring
  • Mentors and develops team members.
  • Instructs teams members on design, configuration work, and assignments.
  • Onboards and trains new team members.
  • Administrative Documentation Requirements
  • Develops policies and procedures in collaboration with clinicians, other system analyst team members, and IT Epic team manager.
  • Creates and maintains system documentation; ensuring that documentation is updated accurately and timely.
  • Guides other team members in ensuring good documentation standards and coordinates efforts to maintain appropriate system documentation.
  • Provides input to components of development of end-user training materials and participates in training efforts.
  • Trains new members of the team, acting as mentor or coach for junior team members by providing guidance and support.
  • Responsible for maintaining revenue mapping in Epic general ledger

Genesis10 is currently seeking a Business Systems Analyst with our client in the healthcare industry. This is a 6-month contract position and is fully remote.

We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst (BA) with a strong background in Pharmacy Benefit Management (PBM) or healthcare systems to support a high-profile, highly visible client engagement. Genesis10 is currently seeking an Implementation Project Manager with FFS Medicaid experience for a 6-7 month contract role with our healthcare client. This role is 100% remote.

Compensation:   $ 75-80 per hour, depending on skill and experience level.

Summary:
The Implementation Project Manager (IPM), Fee for Service (FFS) Medicaid Implementations, can work remotely from anywhere in the US. This role provides project management support for medium and complex projects within New Client Implementations at "Client" Rx. This is a customer-facing role. The key is knowing how to work with FFS Medicaid.

You'll enjoy the flexibility to work remotely from anywhere within the U.S. as you take on some tough challenges.

Responsibilities:
  • Manage the entire client onboarding project for implementation, main contact for the client
  • Acts as a trusted partner to key constituencies by learning their business to anticipate stakeholder needs and concerns
  • Ensures client satisfaction, quality of work, and project profitability
  • Coordinate efforts with internal departments for the creation of clinical and formulary needs
  • Coordinate disruption analysis to impacted membership (if/when applicable)
  • Work with Operations and functional leaders to proactively identify implementation issues and drive their resolution
  • Facilitate meetings at various levels of the organization, including management weekly reviews
  • Monitor, track, and report implementation status and performance, internally and externally
  • Identify implementation risks, implement a mitigation / action plan to drive improved outcomes, communicate to senior leadership
  • Ensure accuracy of plan updates and missed deliverables from all teams
  • Manage pre-implementation audits with the audit department and the client
  • Ability to mentor other team members within implementation, if needed
Required Qualifications:
  • PMP Certification
  • 5+ years of project management experience
  • 3+ years in the healthcare industry specifically in Medicaid and/or Medicare
  • 3+ years implementations
  • 2+ years of experience in Pharmacy Benefit Management
  • 2+ years in a client facing role
  • Experience managing large-scale healthcare projects with teams of 10 or more
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Project, and Word
  • Solid experience in influencing externally with soft power, driving cross – functional collaboration, and negotiating win-win solutions
  • Demonstrated ability to present to all levels of management and audiences
  • Proven ability to ascertain client needs through active listening skills, and consultatively work with clients to achieve business objectives
Preferred Qualifications:
  • Certified Pharmacy Technician
  • 2+ years of PBM client implementation project management experience or Account Management experience
  • Experience managing complex projects with various stakeholders

We have access to additional contract, contract-to-hire, and direct hire positions with various rate ranges.

title: Senior Cloud Engineer
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a Senior Cloud Engineer for our mortgage services client in McLean, VA. This is a 12-month contract requiring 5 days a week onsite.

Summary:
  • Design, implement, and manage Kubernetes clusters on AWS/GCP/Azure, ensuring high availability and scalability.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or AWS CodePipeline.
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using Terraform and AWS CloudFormation.
  • Integrate AWS Lambda functions into platform workflows for event-driven automation.
  • Manage AWS resources such as S3, RDS, and secrets using AWS Secrets Manager or Hashicorp Vault.
  • Implement robust secrets management strategies across platforms and environments.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize system performance, security, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with development, security, and operations teams to ensure seamless platform integration and support.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and AWS best practices.
Required Skills & Qualifications:
  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or equivalent work experience(required)
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud engineering, SRE, or platform engineering roles.
  • Deep expertise in Kubernetes architecture, deployment, scaling, and monitoring.
  • Strong experience in AWS services, including Lambda, S3, RDS, IAM, and VPC.
  • Proficiency in infrastructure-as-code using Terraform and CloudFormation.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD concepts and pipeline implementation.
  • Advanced knowledge of secrets management (AWS Secrets Manager, HashiCorp Vault, etc.).
  • Strong scripting skills (Python, Bash, Go, etc.).
  • Solid understanding of networking, security, and observability in Kubernetes.
  • Familiarity with GitOps practices and tools like Flux or ArgoCD.
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and collaboration skills.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer, etc.) and Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) or similar certification are a plus.
Preferred Skills:
  • Experience with container security and compliance.
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies (Istio, Linkerd, etc.).
  • Knowledge of observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, etc.).
Keys to success in this role:
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Ability to work independently and in a team-oriented environment.

Pay rate range - $80.00- $85.00 an hour

title: IT Security Specialist
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking an IT Security Specialist with our client in the financial industry located in Plano, TX. This is a 12+ month contract position.

Responsibilities:
  • Provide support for Load Balancing infrastructure for client
  • Build relationships with the Line of Businesses (LOB), become members of a global team of load balancing engineers, further improve and maintain Service Request Fulfillment (SRF) process and standards as part of a larger team that is responsible for the health and welfare of the client's load balancing infrastructure
  • Manage end-to-end lifecycle and delivery of application delivery infrastructure
  • Create designs based on industry best practices, engineering standards and security principles
  • Ensure security controls are implemented and operating effectively as part of solutions delivery
  • Code upgrades, vulnerability patching and EOL replacement programs
  • Create detailed implementation plans and runbooks for downstream execution teams
  • Manage a wide variety of technology infrastructure and business aligned projects
  • Collaborate with engineering and operations teams from service design through operations transition process for new services
  • Perform design validation and QA testing of new services to ensure successful production deployment
  • Maintain KPI standards by meeting SLA
  • Reduce change related incidents by maintaining peer review and implementation standards
  • Metrics reporting and presentation to senior leadership teams
  • Participate in and drive collaborative efforts to advance tools, technology, and ways of working to better serve an evolving client base
  • Believe in value of diversity so we can reflect, connect, and meet the diverse needs of our clients and employees around the world
  • Commitment to challenging the status quo and promoting positive change

Requirements:
  • 5-7+ years' network engineering and/or technology management experience
  • 5+ years' of F5 LTM and GTM 1+ years' of F5 APM and ASM experience
  • 1+ years' AVI/VMware experience CCNP, F5 201, and/or demonstrate equivalent work experience
  • Able effectively troubleshoot advanced networking issues in a complex environment with knowledge of commonly used protocols (BGP, HTTPS, TCP/IP, and SSL)
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills and ability to collaborate with other technical areas to define complex configuration designs
  • Subject matter expertise of load balancer, DNS, SSL off loader
  • Functional understanding of F5's API iControl and application integration
  • Expertise in application switching and traffic management, deep knowledge of application requirements (such as persistence)
  • Understand SSL offload and implementation of SSL certificate and Key, and web acceleration and TCP optimization
  • Understanding of SSL Certificate Private Key Infrastructure (PKI) in the SSL Certificate and KEY management and rollover process
  • Expertise in planning, designing, and implementing enterprise-level network security technologies
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Ability to present at an executive level
  • Experience managing large, globally dispersed teams of engineers
  • Ability to interact with clients at all levels
  • Experienced load balancing engineer to be part of a global team

Desired skills:
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience with root cause analysis, risk mitigation, security assessments, analysis of security threats, trends and architecture
  • Functional knowledge of F5 advanced feature modules including web accelerator, application security module, and application policy module
  • Firm understanding of IT service management processes, ITIL certification
  • Python development experience and bash scripting experience
  • Use of mitigation methods including use of network Packet filters and iRules
  • Strives to bring new thoughts and ideas to teams in order to drive innovation and unique solutions
  • Excels in working among diverse viewpoints to determine the best path forward
  • Experience in connecting with a diverse set of clients to understand future business needs – is a continuous learner

title: Legal Consultant (Investment Advisers Act & SEC Filings)
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Part-Time Legal Consultant working 25-30 hours with our client in the financial industry.  

Job Description

Our client, a prestigious player in the financial services sector, is embarking on a major, multi-year initiative. We are seeking a dynamic and skilled legal professional to join their team as a long-term contractor. This isn't just another compliance role—this is a high-impact, "sexy" project at the intersection of law and business strategy, offering engaging work you will genuinely enjoy.

You will be the right-hand to the in-house counsel, serving as the "eyes and ears" on a critical project. Your expertise will be crucial in shaping the regulatory framework, creating key client-facing documents, and ensuring seamless implementation of business objectives within a complex legal landscape.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Regulatory Document Drafting & Management: Take the lead in drafting, preparing, and filing critical regulatory documents with the SEC, with a core focus on Form ADV and ADV Brochures (client-facing disclosures).

  • Advisory Agreement Negotiation: Negotiate Investment Advisory Agreements with clients, leveraging existing templates to secure favorable terms.

  • Strategic Legal Support: Partner with business leaders to understand their objectives, identify legal issues, and determine the applicability of federal securities laws and FINRA rules.

  • Compliance & Process Implementation: Translate legal requirements into actionable business processes and help implement them effectively.

  • Marketing Material Review: Review and approve marketing and advertising materials to ensure full compliance with the standards set forth by the Investment Advisers Act.

What You Bring (Qualifications):

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) degree and active bar membership in good standing.

  • 5+ years of relevant legal experience (candidates with a strong 3+ years will be considered).

  • Deep, hands-on experience with the Investment Advisers Act of 1940 and SEC filing processes is non-negotiable.

  • Proven experience in drafting and negotiating Investment Advisory Agreements.

  • Specific, practical knowledge of Form ADV and ADV Brochure creation.

  • Familiarity with Federal Securities Law; FINRA rules experience is a significant plus.

  • A proactive, business-minded approach with the ability to identify issues, define requirements, and drive projects forward.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to serve as a trusted legal advisor.

Why You'll Love This Role:

  • Engaging & High-Impact Work: Get involved in a fun, challenging, and business-critical project from the ground floor.

  • Long-Term Stability: A multi-year contract offering continuity and the chance to see a major initiative through to completion.

  • Flexibility: A hybrid work model and a ~25-30 hour weekly commitment provide an excellent work-life balance.

  • Strategic Partnership: Act as a key legal partner, not just a reviewer, with direct visibility and impact on the business.


Compensation: $90/per hour W2

  • 2+ years of experience with automated conveyor systems and controls
  • 2+ years of experience in the repair of material handling equipment
  • 2+ years of experience conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures
  • 1+ years of metal and wood fabrication
  • 1+ years of blueprint and electrical schematic reading
  • 1+ year of knowledge of electrical and electronic principles
  • Procedure-based maintenance experience (PM)
  • Ability to use and interpret statistical equipment run metrics such as OEE/Up Time to prioritize accordingly
Preferred Qualifications
  • Associate or higher degree from a vocational school or college with a focus in the Mechanical or Electrical field
  • 2+ years apprenticeship or equivalent experience in the Mechanical or Electrical field
  • Experience with Material Handling Equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and Safety standards

  • 3 or more years of experience as a Java/ J2ee Middleware Engineering 
  • Experience with 1 or more of the following Middleware products: Appian, Software AG WEB METHODS

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills and strong attention to detail

title: Data Scientist: III (Senior)
description:
Genesis10 is seeking a Data Scientist III for a hybrid contract to hire position with a leading client in Columbus, OH.

Location: Easton
Duration: 3-month contract to hire
W2 pay rate: $60-65/hour; Conversion salary: $105k with a 15% bonus

Summary:
Seeking a passionate, data-savvy Senior Data Scientist to join the Enterprise Analytics team to fuel our mission of growth through data-driven insights and opportunity discovery. This dynamic role uses a consultative approach with the business segments to dive into our customer, product, channel, and digital data to uncover opportunities for consumer experience optimization and customer value delivery. You will also enable stakeholders with actionable, intuitive performance insights that provide the business with direction for growth. The ideal candidate will have a robust mix of technical and communication skills, with a passion for optimization, data storytelling, and data visualization. You will collaborate with a centralized team of data scientists as well as teams across the organization including Product, Marketing, Data, Finance, and senior leadership. This is an exciting opportunity to be a key influencer to the company's strategic decisions and to learn and grow with our Analytics team.
 
The Team:
You will be joining a team of analytics and data science professionals within the Enterprise Data & Analytics organization. Team members are highly skilled in a mixture of R, Python, SAS, SQL, Tableau, and Adobe Analytics/Target to perform modeling, visualization, and advanced analytics. Members of the team primarily support the Digital and Omnichannel organizations but are strategically positioned to partner with and support nearly every part of the company including Product, Marketing, Consumer Sales and Operations, Business and Commercial Banks, Private Client Group, Enterprise Payments, and IT. We align with our partners within the Agile development framework and support projects throughout their entire lifecycle from ideation through delivery on the largest and most visible projects undertaken at the company. This highly visible and critical role will be set in a fast-paced environment with the ability to influence not just any single project but the overall direction of the organization.
 
Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Ability to use advanced analytics methods to extract value from business data.
  • Ability to perform large-scale experimentation and build data-driven models to answer business questions.
  • Conducts research on cutting-edge techniques and tools in machine learning/deep learning/artificial intelligence.
  • Determines requirements that will be used to train and evolve deep learning models and algorithms.
  • Influences product teams through presentation of data-based recommendations.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
 
Basic Qualifications:
  • Master's degree completed by Fall 2025 in Computer Science or Information Systems, Decision Sciences, Statistics, Operations Research, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, or a STEM degree
 
  • or in lieu of a Master's degree, Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 3 years’ work experience in analytics or data science
  • Experience with R, RStudio, Python, SAS, SQL, NoSQL
Preferred Qualifications:
 
  • Up-to-date knowledge of machine learning and data analytics tools and techniques
  • Knowledge in predictive modeling methodology
  • Experienced at leveraging both structured and unstructured data sources
  • Willingness and ability to learn new technologies on the job
  • Work and/or educational experience conducting statistical analysis with advanced statistical software, scripting languages, and packages
  • Work and/or educational experience with big data analysis tools and techniques
  • Foundational knowledge of building and deploying predictive models, web scraping, and scalable data pipelines
  • Understanding of statistical methods and skills such as Bayesian Networks Inference, linear and non-linear regression, hierarchical, mixed models/multi-level modeling
  • Experience with Cloud Machine Learning technologies (e.g., AWS Sagemaker)
  • Experience with machine learning environments (e.g., TensorFlow, scikit-learn, caret)
  • Financial Services background
 
About Candidate:
 
  • A curious mind with a thirst for discovery, answers, optimization, and continuous improvement
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to interact effectively across all organizational levels
  • Creative thinker and problem solver, with a strong ability to manage ambiguity/complexity
  • Work effectively in teams as well as independently across multiple tasks while meeting aggressive timelines
  • Experience working in a consumer-centric company and with teams of technical professionals in a cross-functional environment

title: Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
description:
Genesis10 is currently seeking a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) for a 6 month contract role in Eden Prairie, MN. This role is 100% remote

Compensation: $65-72 per hour W2, depending on skill and experience level.

 
Job Description:
Our client is seeking two experienced SDETs to support the AHIP October initiative. This role requires hands-on experience in test automation, a strong command over modern testing frameworks, and excellent communication skills to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
 
Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated test frameworks and test cases using Playwright
  • Collaborate with development and QA teams to ensure high-quality software delivery
  • Participate in test planning, execution, and defect tracking
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of testing processes and tools
 
Required Skills:
  • Proficiency in Playwright for UI test automation
  • Strong programming skills in JavaScript and TypeScript
  • Solid understanding of automation frameworks and best practices
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
 
Nice to Have/Desired Skills:
  • Experience with Cypress or similar end-to-end testing tools
Note: This role may require occasional travel (up to 25%) to Minnesota.
 
 
Compensation:
Hourly W2 pay: $65.00 to $72.00/hour
